name: Suppression Tower 1
notes: The suppression barrage hits Aurana 4 times for 60 damage, with 0.3 seconds between hits. On Brutal it is scheduled every 6 seconds, falling to 1.98 seconds after the tower has been active for 180 seconds; combat can interrupt this schedule. Depending on the tower group, Multi-Target Lock-On deals 40 damage in each radius-1.5 circle after a 4-second warning, and Single-Target Lock-On deals 150 damage in a radius of 1.25. These are scripted abilities, not weapon volleys.

name: Eradicator
notes: The cannon variant uses Railgun: 250 damage on Brutal, in a 2-wide, 30-long rectangle hitting at most 3 targets per shot. The missile variant deals 95 damage per missile in a radius of 1.6 on Brutal. These values include NovaEradicatorDamageBrutal, which replaces the base 75/45 damage. Lock-On deals 16.6667 damage per projectile and has range 15 on Brutal, increasing to 25 when the other Eradicator dies. Mission scripts control the firing patterns and target selection.

name: Zenith Stone
notes: Below 66% life, Psionic Shock retaliates for 25 damage against a nearby enemy, with a 1-second response cooldown. Below 33% life, Unstable Storms creates random radius-1.5 storms. The Temple of the Past overrides storm damage to 4 on initial application and 8 per subsequent 0.571-second tick; its storm debuff lasts 1.5 seconds and is refreshed by the storm area. These are reactive behaviors, not a weapon attack cycle.

name: Void Thrasher TotP 1
notes: Void Barrage launches 4 missiles dealing 2 damage each, spaced 0.4 seconds apart in this mission. Lightning Breath has range 10 and radius 2.2, with a 3-second warning followed by 3 damage pulses spaced 0.5 seconds apart. Each hit deals 3 damage (+5 vs. Armored). On Brutal the mission adds 3 overlapping copies of the breath to the original, for 12 hits total if the target remains in the area (36 damage, or 96 vs. Armored, before mitigation). Breath casts have a 10-second scripted cooldown and interrupt bombardment while enemies are nearby. The mission sets the shared bombardment timer to 2 seconds when a Thrasher of this level spawns (with ±5% timing variation).

name: Void Sliver 1
notes: Unstable Energy deals 100 damage in a radius of 4 after a 4-second warning; the mission selects targets within range 18. Shockwave stuns nearby units, and Death Grip creates crystals that kill their captives when the timer expires. These are mission-scripted abilities. Their initial cooldowns are 20, 14, and 60 seconds respectively on Brutal; after the third and fourth Sliver kills, each cooldown is multiplied by 0.7. Before any Sliver is destroyed, none of these abilities is active.
